observations: Rows5-46 describe global IRQ registers0x00/02/04/06 as readable and writable. Reads observe flags; bit15 semantics concern writes.
Rows47-88 describe global masks0x08/0a/0c/0e as readable and writable. No bank selection is needed for these eight reads.
Rows89-94 mark sample data0x10/12, address0x14/16, reset0x18 and bank selector0x1e write-only. No sample-RAM read port or usage counter is documented here.
Rows95-125 concern the selected voice bank. A read-only probe cannot select every bank because0x1e is write-only. Global flags/masks do not prove all voices stopped.
Documentation is a pinned access contract, not physical device qualification, RAM capacity or transfer completion evidence.
implementation: independent qualification helper; no upstream implementation copied
